title: A bone on Mars in a JPL negative
summary: Joe McMoneagle tells of A bone on Mars in a JPL negative, about unspecified at Mars, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: this is a bone on Mars

plain: A man named Joe McMoneagle says that one of the Mars mapping negatives from the Jet Propulsion Laboratory, the NASA center that runs space probes, shows a bone lying on the surface of Mars. If so, it would mean Mars once had animal life.
